purpose: Customer-facing checkout draft, order placement, and order status API boundary.
businessRules: Authenticate every request with the bearer customer session token before exposing order data.
Require Idempotency-Key for draft creation and final placement, and delegate mutation replay/conflict handling to IdempotentMutationCoordinator.
Use per-customer mutation locks so repeated proceed-to-checkout or confirm-and-pay clicks cannot create overlapping writes.
Draft creation returns a 15-minute checkout order ID before the customer enters checkout details.
Return the standard ApiResponse envelope with backend trace IDs.
GET /api/v1/customer/orders returns lightweight summaries for the authenticated customer's profile order history.
